argument: Twelve unequal cells must read as one suspended material body before they read as a grid of tiles. The oblique span, underside, gaps, and facet hierarchy must carry the image without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, caption, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v040's depth accord, v041's fossil, and v042's moving shadow. It should read as a material computation, not a generic WebGL sculpture or tile demo.

The visitor must find and cross a grain, not select a cell, wait on a site, or close a circuit. An incomplete or misaligned trace must remain geometry-neutral; pointer, touch, keyboard, and controls must agree.

Only a grain-aligned trace beyond the resistance threshold may change actual remote facet count, depth, warp, ridge, and neighbouring geometry. Cursor lines, colour, status, and prose cannot substitute for produced form.
The source cell and its traced position must remain exact. The archive must appear in an untouched remote facet, proving that material consequence is displaced from the hand.
Resistance must alter how the remote facet is made, not merely its brightness. More triangular planes, changed z, warp, ridge, and inherited neighbours must remain visible after the trace ends.
Four resistance transfers must compound in one membrane. Delete must reconstruct the exact preceding cells, and release must return to the deterministic quiet membrane.

Generated WEBGL triangular faces, extruded side planes, facet ridges, and seeded membrane cells are the medium. No screenshot, imported model, texture, SVG fallback, or stock particle library may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from programmable material behaviour, pressure, direction, and field logic into a resistance threshold that changes remote geometry production. No brush preset, watercolor, hatching, grain, palette, composition, source code, example, API, or surface vocabulary is copied.

v043 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal behaviour, medium, and viewer task: depth sheets, waiting fossil, and moving shards become one real 3D membrane in which a grain passage re-produces an untouched remote facet.

Delete v043 if an incomplete trace commits, the source cell changes, resistance is cosmetic, every receiver is the same, the blind body reads as generic 3D tiles, later transfers reset, or lifting is inexact.
